source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Rank similarity is conditional equality in distribution of rank variables given U; Proposition 5 assumes full complier support; footnote 29 says that without it the bounding quantiles must be generalized and extremal comonotonic effects may fail joint attainability by one rank-similar DGP.

source_verification_receipts.locator: publisher abstract and bibliographic record, pp. 763–814
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper studies identified regions expressible as transformations of Aumann expectations of set-valued random variables and establishes Hausdorff-consistent estimation and associated inference.
Under its maintained assumptions and a Gaussian limit, standard-bootstrap consistency is equivalent to full Hadamard differentiability tangentially to the Gaussian support.
The paper gives bootstrap calibrated-projection confidence intervals for components and smooth functions of partially identified parameters in moment (in)equality models.
The paper constructs random sets covering an identified argmin set or its image and gives conditions for pointwise and uniform asymptotic validity.
The paper develops estimators and asymptotic distributions for sharp treatment-effect-distribution bounds and notes possible failure of the same-size standard bootstrap.

The preprint gives a closed-form categorical-IV compatible potential-outcome characterization and computation of confidence regions for convex functions of joint counterfactual probabilities; no path-union or hyperspace-radius result is stated in the inspected text.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Define the interior legal-law domain explicitly as the subset of the closed compatibility polytope satisfying the strict first-stage inequalities, and use that domain consistently in the continuity and local-limit statements.

Strengthen the path-drop lower bound from the single three-outcome submodel to a relative-open class of nondegenerate path-drop faces, with a common separation constant; this would turn the diagnostic into a generic obstruction.
Resolve the active-germ OEQ by proving stratum-stable recovery of the complete semilinear Hausdorff-loss partition, including a computable Gaussian calibration theorem on structural-zero faces.

recommended_next_step: Advance the field-tier kernel to Stage 0, retaining the active-germ result as the explicit open statistical rung.
